issue: Recurring /loop macro: Wave 6 research and implementation of trios tmp-zero cleanup.
problem: Three trios Rust rings still used /tmp in unit tests and sample strings: clade-experience wrote size-test fixtures under /tmp, clade-audit read/wrote test files under /tmp, and clade-launchd tests used /tmp as sample WorkingDirectory values.
fix: Added tempfile = '3' as dev-dependency to clade-experience and clade-audit; rewrote tests to use isolated tempfile::tempdir() directories with automatic cleanup. Replaced /tmp sample strings in clade-launchd tests with project-relative .trinity/dev/launchd-wd. Updated portable-paths/SKILL.md and created tmp-zero/SKILL.md.
tests_added: No new tests; existing tests migrated to tempfile.
verification: grep -RIn '/tmp' rings/RUST-*/src/ returned zero matches; cargo test -p clade-experience -p clade-launchd -p clade-audit --all-features passed 37 tests; cargo test --workspace --all-features passed; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features clean; ./build.sh OK; ASCII scan of changed files clean.
pattern: Use tempfile::tempdir() for test scratch directories and project-relative .trinity/ subdirs for persistent runtime state; never write /tmp paths into workspace Rust source.
anti_pattern: Do not use /tmp for test fixtures or runtime state; do not manually clean up test directories when tempfile Drop handles it.
